correctness.rationale: The quotient model has D_i reducing layers A⊗I+T⊗B_d with B_d weights sqrt((l+1)/(l+d)). Orthogonal defect identities yield R_l=a_lP-b_lQ; P,Q have overlap alpha=|eta_i prime(0)|. For alpha<1 its 2×2 eigenvalues have product -a_l b_l(1-alpha²), opposite signs and absolute asymptotic (d-1)sqrt(1-alpha²)/l. Counting 2D_i branches and monotone inversion gives n mu_n and the logarithmic sum equal 2D_i(d-1)sqrt(1-alpha²). For alpha=1 Schwarz equality makes P=Q and sum(a_l-b_l)=1, so trace norm is D_i. The bundled checker verifies exact rational block identities and finite diagnostics, not the infinite proof.
